programs.title: My Village is a National Treasure Ep.1
programs.desc: Dingcun village in Shanxi has a deep cultural legacy borne from a long historical tradition. Yet despite its rich resources, the village remained stagnant for years, described by local scholars as “begging for food while holding a golden bowl.” Now, Dingcun is charting a new course, developing its rural tourism by embracing its unique cultural assets.
